proposals.evidence: Turner jvalati gives Hindi jalnā, eastern jarab and Oriya jaḷibā in the intransitive burn family. These are single inflected verbs, kept distinct from Lahnda geminate jall- (*jvalyate) and from transitive kindle forms.

proposals.evidence: Turner *dvalati is explicitly intransitive burn, with Hindi barnā/balnā, Old Marwari balaï and Gujarati baḷvũ. The survey’s simple baḷ-/bar-/bol- responses and inflections fit that family. Long-vowel transitive bāl- kindle responses are kept separate.
